image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface (likely a blanket). The bib features a white central panel with vertical pleats or tucks, bordered by a wide strip of pink fabric with large white and smaller green polka dots. The entire perimeter is trimmed with light blue gathered ruffle lace. A yellow ribbon or tie is visible at the top neck area.
